headline: New York City wins $131.5 million DoorDash settlement for delivery workers
dek: The agreement will send more than $115 million to over 260,000 workers after a city investigation found underpayments, late payments and unpaid work.
body: New York City officials announced a $131.5 million settlement with DoorDash that will compensate more than 260,000 delivery workers and resolve a city investigation into alleged violations of the city's delivery-worker pay laws.

The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection said its review found that DoorDash failed to pay some workers for completed work, paid others late and excluded categories of trip and on-call time when calculating compensation. The investigation examined 152 million payments and 110 million hours of work between April 2022 and June 2026.

More than $115 million of the agreement will go directly to workers, while more than $16 million will cover civil penalties and other costs, according to the Mayor's Office. The city said payments will begin this fall, with personalized notices planned for workers identified as having experienced underpayments during the main review period.

The settlement also creates a monitoring system intended to help the city detect future violations. The Workers Justice Project and the Workers' Algorithm Observatory are expected to develop software that lets workers capture information shown in the DoorDash app about their trips and pay and share it with city officials.

DoorDash said in a statement that the errors involved technical problems and complicated deliveries, including trips that crossed city boundaries or were canceled or partially completed. The company acknowledged that workers should have been paid in full and on time, while the city described the agreement as its largest worker settlement.
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: New York City Reaches $131.5 Million DoorDash Worker Settlement
seoDescription: New York City says a $131.5 million DoorDash settlement will compensate more than 260,000 delivery workers and add new monitoring.
